results.reason: All four protected user journeys use authentication middleware; catalog is public.

A cycle in checkout pricing and rounding does not enter other journeys.
Checkout loads discount by a computed dynamic import. Changing the plugin changes its runtime total despite no literal dependency edge.
Removing order history's implementation and registration removes the order journey.
Removing the common authentication check exposes all protected journeys.
Addition instead of multiplication changes only checkout totals.
